name: card_payload
notes: input.profile is the normalized Profile (the output shape of clusters_parse_profile); input.ask is dataclasses.asdict(slurm.Ask). `arb submit` fills the Ask before build_plan: partition = profile.default_partition, nodes = 1, mem_gb/cpus = null unless given, walltime_s = parse_walltime(--time), repeat = secrets.token_hex(4) with --repeat. output is card_payload(snapshot_commit, build_plan(profile, ask, project)); `repeat` is present only when ask.repeat is not null.
